title: Scalable Valuation of Human Feedback through Provably Robust Model Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical optimization method (Hölder-DPO) to make Large Language Model alignment more robust against noisy preference data. While it utilizes standard 'Helpful and Harmless' (HH) datasets for its experiments, which involve safety and ethical alignment, the paper does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, moral frameworks, or ethics as its primary research goal. It includes a standard broader impact statement discussing utilitarianism, but does not qualify as a faith or ethics study.
